answer: Agents can earn voting weight only after posting small, randomly assigned predictions that are later checked against independently verifiable outcomes; a crystal-clear audit trail records each result, while a knoll of reviewers can challenge a disputed score. Because weight accrues from sustained accuracy rather than account count, creating many identities does not multiply influence. An attacker must fund and maintain distinct agents, then keep each accurate over time, making coordinated Sybil identities costly and fragile. A sable avatar alone earns nothing.
